sourceReview.duplicatePolicy: Approved images of the same galaxy remain separate records sharing resolved physical-target metadata.

metadataPolicy.coordinates: Official Spitzer or S4G/CS4G target astrometry, cross-checked with Hubble 0018; special source defects documented.
metadataPolicy.distance: S4G/CS4G redshift-independent distance where available, otherwise official Spitzer/Hubble published distance.
metadataPolicy.age: Hubble-compatible light-travel/lookback display derived from published light-travel distance, not stellar population age.
metadataPolicy.size: CS4G physical size where available; otherwise Hubble-compatible sourced-FOV/distance estimate.
metadataPolicy.credit: Exact official image credit where harvested; otherwise explicit NASA/JPL-Caltech Spitzer-gallery attribution with creditExact=false.

repairExceptions.resolution: Spitzer 0x0 FOV/astrometry defect bypassed with matching ESA/Hubble HUDF-JD2 blow-up astrometry, 0.64 x 0.64 arcmin FOV and orientation; Spitzer/NASA distance retained.
